CANDIDATES.COMPARATOR: days 8-21 of the same month outside the holiday windows
CONFOUNDERS: weekday composition of state days (removed by weekday-class standardization)
monthly expiry on the last Friday (that day is excluded)
year-end and CN Golden Week holidays (fixed-date exclusions)
floating holidays (CN New Year, US Labor Day) remain as noise
CANDIDATES.DEPENDENCE: months are time-separated; slow participation regimes cancel inside a month; residual serial dependence across months is checked with a moving-block SE
CANDIDATES.EXACT_CLAIM: Mean over calendar months of [mean z(log daily trade count) over turn-of-month days minus mean z over days 8-21 of the same month] is positive and at least 0.5 comparator-SD, Holm-adjusted two-sided sign-flip p <= 0.05 within TF-G01-A.
CANDIDATES.EXPECTED_NOMINAL_N: about 60 discovery months, 36 replication months; about 3-4 state and 14 comparator days per month
CANDIDATES.EXPOSURE: turn-of-month days: the last UTC calendar day of the previous month and days 1-3; minus the last-Friday expiry day and the fixed holiday windows Dec 24-Jan 2 and Oct 1-7
CANDIDATES.INFERENCE_CLASS: CONTEXT_DESCRIPTIVE / UNCONDITIONAL / ATOMIC; sign-flip over month units
CANDIDATES.MECHANISM: Recurring fiat-rail cash flows (salary-linked purchases, monthly DCA plans, fund subscriptions and month-end marks) concentrate around the turn of the month, so participation rises on the first days of a month.
CANDIDATES.NAME: TOM_PARTICIPATION
CANDIDATES.OUTCOME: log of the UTC-day trade count (Binance 1m `count`; BitMEX 5m `trades`), standardized per year and weekday class (Mon-Fri / Sat-Sun), label-blind
CANDIDATES.PRACTICAL_BAR: 0.5 comparator-SD (the same product-relevance bar as R03: a shift that roughly doubles the rate of extreme-day flags)
PRIOR_OVERLAP: R03-A2 last-Friday expiry hour (different clock; that day excluded)
R03-C weekday/session clock (weekday handled by standardization)
GV0V03L40-C028 tax-year-end panel turnover (December only, panel, losers)
CANDIDATES.PRODUCT_RELEVANCE: activity ranks and baselines in the briefing; a turn-of-month shift would mis-calibrate a 30-day activity baseline
CANDIDATES.RED_TEAM: Lookahead: none (calendar). Hidden conditioning: none. Overlap: state day -1 belongs to the next month's unit only. Pseudo-replication: month units. Multiplicity: Holm within card. Epoch: calendar years, gate per contract. Venue artifact: trade count changes with fragmentation, absorbed by per-year standardization. Exposed-outcome leakage: no day-of-month statistic was ever reported. Survives.
CANDIDATES.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: No prior card tests the day-of-month cash-flow clock; turn-of-month appears in no ledger, memory or generator record.

CONFOUNDERS: volatility regime (nuisance diagnostic: prior 24h RV, lagged target)
CANDIDATES.EXACT_CLAIM: As G01-A1 with target z(log daily range ln(max high / min low)).
CANDIDATES.INFERENCE_CLASS: CONTEXT_DESCRIPTIVE / UNCONDITIONAL / ATOMIC; sign-flip over month units
CANDIDATES.MECHANISM: If turn-of-month flows are directional and lumpy, they move price more on those days than mid-month, widening the daily range.
CANDIDATES.NAME: TOM_RANGE
CANDIDATES.OUTCOME: log daily range over the UTC day, standardized per year and weekday class
CANDIDATES.PRODUCT_RELEVANCE: range ranks behind the unusual-hour and daily context
CANDIDATES.RED_TEAM: As G01-A1. The range target is the product-facing one; the participation target is the direct mechanism observable. Both are kept as separate cells (Holm m <= 3). Survives.

CANDIDATES.COMPARATOR: 23:00-24:00 UTC on days 8-21 of the same month
CONFOUNDERS: one state hour per unit: rare-event power is the expected failure
daily 00:00 UTC funding and candle close affect state and comparator alike
CANDIDATES.EXACT_CLAIM: Mean over months of [z(log range of 23:00-24:00 UTC on the last day of the month) minus mean z of the same hour on days 8-21] is positive and at least 0.5 SD, Holm within TF-G01-A.
CANDIDATES.EXPECTED_NOMINAL_N: about 55 months with one state hour each
CANDIDATES.EXPOSURE: 23:00-24:00 UTC on the last day of the month (December excluded by the year-end window)
CANDIDATES.INFERENCE_CLASS: CONTEXT_DESCRIPTIVE / UNCONDITIONAL / ATOMIC; sign-flip over month units
CANDIDATES.MECHANISM: Crypto funds and treasuries mark month-end NAV at 00:00 UTC; rebalancing and marking trades concentrate in the last UTC hour of the month.
CANDIDATES.NAME: MONTH_END_MARK_HOUR
CANDIDATES.OUTCOME: log range of the hour, standardized per year and weekday class over all days' 23:00 hours
PRIOR_OVERLAP: R03-A2/A3 (monthly single-hour cells closed INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK at feasibility)
CANDIDATES.PRODUCT_RELEVANCE: the unusual-hour flag at the month boundary
CANDIDATES.RED_TEAM: Rare-event N is the expected failure; it is sent to the compiler rather than closed by the author, because the R03 precedent is a compiler decision. Survives to feasibility.
CANDIDATES.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: Different clock (month-end mark, not expiry). Kept so that the compiler, not the author, decides its power.

CANDIDATES.COMPARATOR: the same relative quantity in pre-launch weeks
CONFOUNDERS: US equity close and CME daily settlement also sit at 16:00 NY (present in both eras; DiD)
hour-specific trends unrelated to ETFs (not removable; stated as a blocking assumption)
single post year: epochs are 2024 quarters
CANDIDATES.DEPENDENCE: serial dependence across weeks (4-week blocks); the within-day difference removes day-level volatility
CANDIDATES.EXACT_CLAIM: Difference-in-differences over ISO weeks: mean over post-launch weeks of d_week minus mean over pre-launch weeks of d_week is positive and at least 0.5 comparator-SD, two-sided block-permutation p <= 0.05; d_week = mean over NYSE full trading days of [z(log quote volume 15:00-16:00 NY) - mean z(log quote volume 13:00-14:00, 14:00-15:00 NY)].
CANDIDATES.EXPECTED_NOMINAL_N: about 209 pre and 50 post weeks; about 4.8 trading days per week
CANDIDATES.FAMILY: G-adjacent / SCHEDULED_REFERENCE_FIXING (ETF era; not FOMC/CPI/NFP; not CME monthly settlement)
CANDIDATES.INFERENCE_CLASS: CONTEXT_DESCRIPTIVE / UNCONDITIONAL / ATOMIC; block permutation of era labels over 4-week blocks
CANDIDATES.MECHANISM: US spot bitcoin ETFs (trading from 2024-01-11) strike NAV on reference rates computed over 15:00-16:00 New York. Authorized-participant and market-maker execution and the associated CME basis activity concentrate in that window on NYSE trading days, raising its participation relative to the adjacent afternoon hours.
CANDIDATES.NAME: ETF_FIXING_HOUR_PARTICIPATION
CANDIDATES.OUTCOME: log quote volume of the fixing hour relative to the two preceding hours, standardized per year on a common scale across the three hours
PRIOR_OVERLAP: R03-C4 Friday 15:00-16:00 NY vs Tue-Thu (different comparator and question; null)
GV0CAL-C004 CME monthly settlement fixing (blocked on confounding)
D12 US-clock anchoring (profile shift at DST; different identification)

CANDIDATES.RED_TEAM: Lookahead: none (calendar and launch date are public before T). Confounding: the hour also hosts the equity close and CME daily settle, handled by DiD against pre-launch weeks; ETF-unrelated hour-specific trends cannot be removed and are stated. Replication: no historical ETF era exists; prospective only, against the frozen pre-launch mean. Range target not added, to keep a single primary cell. Survives.
